mamFollow:
API REFERENCE / MAM
Join a MAM manager
POST
/v1/oms/{instance}/mam/follow
Bearer token
Write

Creates, or re-activates, the MAM relationship on this instance.

The follower's current trading balance is frozen as starting_balance, the high-water mark the manager must beat before earning a share; the manager's current share_percent is copied onto the row.

method defaults to multiplier and is NOT validated; multiplier <= 0 becomes 1.

Behavior & account differences
Choose an available account

Examples use paper. First call GET /oms/_instances and replace the instance with a slug available to your account. Features vary by broker and account type.

Path parameters
instance
string
required

The trading account (instance) slug.

Engine accounts: paper, paper-net, real, real-net.

External venue accounts: binance, zerodha (see the venue notes on each operation).

Only the instances this install is licensed for exist; GET /oms/_instances lists them.

An unknown slug answers 404 no such OMS instance: <slug>.

mamUnfollow:
API REFERENCE / MAM
Leave a MAM manager
POST
/v1/oms/{instance}/mam/unfollow
Bearer token
Write

Sets the active relationship with this master to 'ended'.

No settlement or money movement happens here; profit shares are taken per closed trade.

On a venue account (binance, zerodha): not supported; answers 501.
